channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Steve Kerr | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Steve Kerr from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“For the first time in my career, Coach (Steve) Kerr told me towards the end of last year, he pulled me to the side, he's like, Draymond, I want you shooting the three. And I was like, oh shit. Like it was like a, it was like a out of body out of body experience,because I had never really heard him like confidently look me in my eyes and say to me like, yo, I want you shooting the basketball. Even when I was shooting the ball great, it was just something that I had never heard. And so when he told me, like the confidence level raised immediately, like, oh man, like Coach want me to shoot.”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Sep 18, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Steve Kerr
item.description:
“To be honest not really, but I know coach Spo’s story…I know him and Steve Kerr worked together with Team USA and Steve had nothing but great things to say… I know it’s a demanding atmosphere and that’s what attracted me.”

Klay Thompson on Steve Kerr, Aug 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Chris Paul, Steve Kerr, James Harden
item.description:
D'Antoni on the James Harden and Chris Paul Rockets:

“We thought we were the best team in the league by far that year for sure. And we had Golden State on the ropes, with their Big 3 -- Big 4, actually, they'll probably have four Hall-of-Fame guys going in. They were good, and Steve Kerr does a great job. We had 'em, you know? We had 'em, and just, Chris [Paul] got hurt, and that's just the way it goes. And then we missed 27 3s in a row, which didn't help. Analytically, I know that's not good! I knew it wasn't when we were doing it, but just a great team.”

Mike D'Antoni on Chris Paul, Steve Kerr, James Harden, Aug 14, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Yaxel Lendeborg on his early conversations with Steve Kerr:

“He doesn’t normally play rookies as much. He has a history of that. But the way the team is looking right now, I’m going to have a really good chance to play, maybe even start.”

Yaxel Lendeborg on Steve Kerr, Jun 26, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Steve Kerr, Gregg Popovich
item.description:
“You know,Steve Kerr, Gregg Popovich — they were guys that went deep into their bench, and they both always used to say, ‘It's not about now, it's about the postseason,’”

Mike Brown on Steve Kerr, Gregg Popovich, May 28, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Derek Harper on Steve Kerr, BJ Armstrong
item.description:
“Michelle, they switched me off of my guy, BJ (Armstrong), Steve Kerr. They switched me onto Mike. And I can't make this up. His exact words were, Harper, couple of things. You're pretty good defensively. But it's too late. I'm already hot. So don't worry about it. You're not going to stop me not today. Those were his words. And there were times you couldn't stop Mike. There were times where you couldn't stop him. You can make it difficult, but greatness, you got to show a lot of different looks in order to slow it down.”

Derek Harper on Steve Kerr, BJ Armstrong, May 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Here is Steph Curry on Steve Kerr’s future:

“I want coach to be happy. I want him to be excited for the job. I want him to believe he’s the right guy for the job.”

Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr, Apr 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Stephen Curry
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“When you have a leader like Steve Kerr, who always knows the right thing to say, and when you have a leader like Steph Curry, that you can always rally around,that you know is going to be there giving everything he’s got—and also one of the greatest players we’ve ever seen—when you’re following two guys like that, things like this are possible.”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Stephen Curry, Apr 16, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Draymond on Steve Kerr:

“Steph doesn't want another coach. Nobody wants that. We won 4 championships under coach Kerr. If he stops today he's a hall of fame coach. As long as we have a Steve Kerr wanting to coach this team you're not gonna go and find a better coach. That's not a worry of mine or anybody in this organization”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Apr 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on facing Steph Curry in the Play-In Tournament:

“He’s one of the greatest players to play this game… Even if it’s just a pickup game, just being able to share the floor with a player like that— being coached by Steve Kerr, also playing with Draymond, that unit over there of championship pedigree. It’s a great opportunity. You can’t take it for granted.”

Kawhi Leonard on Steve Kerr, Apr 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr
item.description:
“Joe went out and hired Steve Kerr when nobody believed that was the right answer. He'll always do right by people. As tough as he is, when you get around that tough ass exterior ... there's an incredible human being.”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Apr 6, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr, Draymond Green
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Steph on Draymond and Steve Kerr's exchange:

“They were just having a good conversation. It's kind of for them to talk about not me. I'm pretty sure we know how to be professional though”

Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr, Draymond Green, Dec 23, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Randy Brown on Steve Kerr, Phil Jackson, Ron Harper, John Salley, Toni Kukoc, Jud Buechler, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jason Caffey, Scott Burrell
item.description:
Randy Brown:

“It would be an honor for the Bulls fans to see Michael, Scottie and Dennis. Phil Jackson. Steve Kerr. Toni Kukoc, Ron Harper, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jud Buechler, John Salley, Buddha Edwards, Scott Burrell, Jason Caffey. I had some great teammates along the way, and Bulls fans would love to acknowledge that this is a championship city.“I’m not going to let it go. I’m hoping it will happen sooner rather than later. Even though everyone’s read in the media about Michael and Scottie’s differences, all that stuff, I hope it can all come to fruition, that we can hug each other one last time. And then from there, we can see where it goes.”

Randy Brown on Steve Kerr, Phil Jackson, Ron Harper, John Salley, Toni Kukoc, Jud Buechler, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jason Caffey, Scott Burrell, Dec 19, 2025. Source: ESportsBets.

item.title: Cameron Johnson on Steve Kerr, Mark Jackson, Nick Nurse, Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Cameron Johnson on Tom Thibodeau’s firing:

“It’s a copycat league and some teams have done it with a lot of success. You look at Golden State going from Mark Jackson to Steve Kerr, championships, dynasty run. You look at um Toronto going from Dwayne Casey to Nick Nurse and immediately coming up with a championship. So, I think that's kind of set a a precedent that like this can be a successful a a formula for winning to getting over the hump.”

Cameron Johnson on Steve Kerr, Mark Jackson, Nick Nurse, Tom Thibodeau, Jun 4, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Steve Kerr, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
DeMarcus Cousins:

“I think they lost (Kuminga). I think Steve Kerr ruined that relationship with the DNPs. We've seen this happen time and time again when it comes to him and dealing with young talent. He just doesn't handle young talent well. He doesn't develop young talent. I mean, out of the years he's been there, we've seen one guy develop under Steve Kerr—and they ran him off as well—and that was Jordan Poole. So when it comes to young talent, I just don't think they handle it well. And I can see Kaminga being on the move.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Steve Kerr, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga, May 21, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jonathan Kuminga on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Jonathan Kuminga on his relationship with Steve Kerr:

“We’ve had ups and downs. But he helped me to get here.”

Jonathan Kuminga on Steve Kerr, May 15, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Steve Kerr, Michael Jordan
item.description:
Edwards has 15 points on 4-for-7 shooting in his 14 postseason clutch minutes, and he has fortified that effort with five assists and no turnovers -- the most assists without a turnover in clutch time by any player in the 2025 playoffs.

“My trainer [Chris] Hines always tells me, 'Michael Jordan had Steve Kerr,'”

Anthony Edwards on Steve Kerr, Michael Jordan, May 14, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Stephen Curry
item.description:
“The beautiful part about being in the space that we're in is, Steve Kerr, Steph Curry and myself all disagree with mortgaging off the future of this organization, saying that we're going for it right now,”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Stephen Curry, Jan 13, 2025. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Buddy Hield on Steve Kerr, Stephen Curry, Draymond Green
item.description:
“Steph [Curry] and Steve [Kerr] reaching out to me during free agency, communicating [on] just being here, you know — Steve and Steph, and Draymond, and everybody,”

Buddy Hield on Steve Kerr, Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Dec 9, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Gary Payton II on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Gary Payton II:

“(Kerr) didn't really mention (the election) or spoke too much on it. We're just trying to be locked in and ready for tonight.”

Gary Payton II on Steve Kerr, Nov 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr
item.description:
But after the Warriors won the title over Boston in 2022, Curry’s truth came out regarding the missing piece of his resume.

“In ’22, when we were on our way back from Boston, I made a joke (with Kerr) about how this is the only thing I hadn’t done, and pretty much softly committed there,”

Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr, Aug 11, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr
item.description:
“And you know, (Warriors coach Steve Kerr) made a joke. He's like, sometimes you can't really find Klay in the offseason, and you don't really hear from him as much, and then he shows up at training camp ready to go. “I kind of have this idea that October, he'll still (show up) like, ‘Hey guys, what's up?’ But I know it's not happening.”

Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr, Jul 8, 2024. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Mark Jackson on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Mark Jackson:

“If he gets the opportunity to coach a legitimate team, you're going to win some games. Coaching a team that isn't good is more challenging. If given a strong team, he'll win games. It's about the opportunity you get. Steve Kerr turns down the Knicks job to coach the Warriors;he's a brilliant basketball mind and has done an incredible job. If he had taken the Knicks job, his career as a coach wouldn't be where it is today. He's been nothing but great to me, and I respect him. He'd tell you it's about the job that he took propelled him to greatness.”

Mark Jackson on Steve Kerr, May 12, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Klay Thompson:

“But it[Steve Kerr's coaching] just did a few tweaks and a little couple modifications to the offensive system that just did wonders for my game and obviously Steph, but it did so much for me as far as just being an off-ball cutter and a mover and a floor spacer.”

Klay Thompson on Steve Kerr, Apr 9, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Draymond Green on Kerr’s two-year contract extension:

“I think it’s incredible. Wouldn’t want to finish my time here with any other coach. What he’s meant to this franchise…the winning ways that he brought here, you can’t replace that … he got what he deserved.”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Feb 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Coach Kerr came to visit me after shootaround and we sat in the yard, he cried, I cried.”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Jan 9, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr
item.description:
“That’s the one piece of the resume that coach [Steve Kerr] always likes to joke that I don’t have,”

Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr, Jul 18, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr
item.description:
“Ultimately, your team has to get better to win back-to-back championships. I'm not sure this team got better… This wasn't a better team than we had last year… Like Steve [Kerr] said, it maxed out.”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, May 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: LeBron James on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Lakers’ LeBron James on Steve Kerr’s flopping allegations:

“We’re just not a team that goes out there looking for flopping opportunities. That’s just not us. It’s actually never been any team I’ve played on in my 20 years.”

LeBron James on Steve Kerr, May 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Steve Kerr
item.description:
Darvin Ham on Steve Kerr’s comments on the Lakers flopping:

“I just control what I can control, which is coaching my team. I don’t go down the rabbit hole of blaming officials.”

Darvin Ham on Steve Kerr, May 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.
